# eslint-plugin-express-security

Guide for AI coding assistants using this plugin in a project. To change the plugin's own source, read https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/blob/main/AGENTS.md instead.

> ESLint Express security rules — detects permissive CORS, missing CSRF protection, missing helmet headers, insecure cookies, and GraphQL introspection in production.

## Enable it

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint-plugin-express-security
```

Requires ESLint ^8.40.0 || ^9.0.0 || ^10.0.0 and Node >=22.13.0.

Flat config files (`eslint.config.*`) are found by ESLint 8.57 and newer; on ESLint 9 and 10 they are the default.

```js
// eslint.config.mjs
import expressSecurity from 'eslint-plugin-express-security';

export default [expressSecurity.configs.recommended];
```

Each preset is one flat config object: put it in the array as an element, do not spread it. Rule ids are prefixed `express-security/`. Add it to the config you already have; do not remove other plugins. TypeScript files need a TypeScript parser in the config (`typescript-eslint`).

Use it alongside `eslint-plugin-security`, not instead of it: keep that plugin if the project has it. Measured overlap and the limits of both: https://eslint.interlace.tools/docs/getting-started/with-eslint-plugin-security

## Presets

| Preset        | Rules | Errors | Warnings |
| ------------- | ----- | ------ | -------- |
| `recommended` | 25    | 16     | 9        |
| `strict`      | 28    | 28     | 0        |
| `api`         | 9     | 9      | 0        |
| `graphql`     | 1     | 1      | 0        |

### `recommended`

25 rules:

- `require-helmet` (error): Require helmet middleware for security headers in Express.js applications.
- `no-permissive-cors` (error): Disallow overly permissive CORS configurations (wildcard origin, origin: true).
- `require-csrf-protection` (warn): Require CSRF protection middleware for state-changing HTTP methods.
- `no-insecure-cookie-options` (error): Require secure cookie flags (httpOnly, secure, sameSite) in Express.js.
- `require-rate-limiting` (error): Require rate-limiting middleware in Express.js applications.
- `no-graphql-introspection-production` (warn): Disallow GraphQL introspection in production environments.
- `no-cors-credentials-wildcard` (error): Disallow credentials: true with wildcard CORS origin (CVE-2024-25124).
- `require-express-body-parser-limits` (warn): Require size limits on Express.js body parsers to prevent DoS attacks.
- `no-express-unsafe-regex-route` (error): Disallow ReDoS-vulnerable regular expressions in Express.js route patterns.
- `no-exposed-debug-endpoints` (error): Detect debug endpoints without auth in Express applications.
- `no-user-controlled-redirect` (error): Disallow res.redirect() with values directly from req.query / req.body / req.params.
- `no-host-header-in-links` (error): Disallow building absolute URLs (reset/verification links) from the Host or X-Forwarded-Host request header.
- `no-error-details-in-response` (error): Disallow sending caught error objects, stacks, or spreads of them in HTTP responses.
- `no-sensitive-data-in-query` (warn): Disallow reading sensitive-named parameters (password, token, secret, ...) from req.query.
- `no-user-controlled-render-locals` (error): Disallow res.render() with locals or view names sourced wholesale from req.body / req.query / req.params.
- `no-static-root-exposure` (error): Disallow express.static() roots that expose the application directory and any serve-index usage.
- `require-case-insensitive-path-guard` (warn): Require case-insensitive comparison when guarding protected paths via req.path / req.url / req.originalUrl.
- `require-query-type-guard` (warn): Require a type guard or String() coercion before calling string methods on req.query values.
- `no-disabled-helmet-protections` (error): Disallow disabling helmet security-header defaults: contentSecurityPolicy, frameguard/xFrameOptions, noSniff/xContentTypeOptions, referrerPolicy, hidePoweredBy/xPoweredBy, crossOriginResourcePolicy, crossOriginOpenerPolicy.
- `require-strict-transport-security` (error): Require a Strict-Transport-Security header with a long max-age and includeSubDomains.
- `no-unsafe-csp-directives` (error): Disallow Content-Security-Policy directives that permit 'unsafe-inline', 'unsafe-eval', wildcard sources, or unrestricted framing.
- `no-permissive-trust-proxy` (error): Disallow unconditional 'trust proxy' — it makes req.ip client-controlled.
- `require-route-authentication` (warn): Require authentication on routes that expose a critical function (account, credential, payment, configuration).
- `no-client-controlled-authorization` (warn): Disallow authorization decisions taken on request-supplied role, permission or identity values.
- `no-idor-resource-access` (warn): Disallow fetching a resource by a request-supplied key in a handler with no principal in scope.

### `strict`

Everything in `recommended` plus 3 more (some shared rules run at a different severity here):

- `no-missing-cors-check` (error): Detects missing CORS validation (wildcard CORS, missing origin check).
- `no-missing-csrf-protection` (error): Detects missing CSRF token validation in POST/PUT/DELETE requests.
- `no-missing-security-headers` (error): Detects missing security headers in HTTP responses.

### `api`

9 rules:

- `require-helmet` (error): Require helmet middleware for security headers in Express.js applications.
- `no-disabled-helmet-protections` (error): Disallow disabling helmet security-header defaults: contentSecurityPolicy, frameguard/xFrameOptions, noSniff/xContentTypeOptions, referrerPolicy, hidePoweredBy/xPoweredBy, crossOriginResourcePolicy, crossOriginOpenerPolicy.
- `require-strict-transport-security` (error): Require a Strict-Transport-Security header with a long max-age and includeSubDomains.
- `no-unsafe-csp-directives` (error): Disallow Content-Security-Policy directives that permit 'unsafe-inline', 'unsafe-eval', wildcard sources, or unrestricted framing.
- `no-permissive-trust-proxy` (error): Disallow unconditional 'trust proxy' — it makes req.ip client-controlled.
- `no-permissive-cors` (error): Disallow overly permissive CORS configurations (wildcard origin, origin: true).
- `require-csrf-protection` (error): Require CSRF protection middleware for state-changing HTTP methods.
- `no-insecure-cookie-options` (error): Require secure cookie flags (httpOnly, secure, sameSite) in Express.js.
- `require-rate-limiting` (error): Require rate-limiting middleware in Express.js applications.

### `graphql`

1 rule:

- `no-graphql-introspection-production` (error): Disallow GraphQL introspection in production environments.

## Other Interlace plugins by dependency

If the project also depends on one of these, add the matching plugin the same way:

- `express`, `fastify`, `koa`, `@hapi/hapi`, `restify`, `hono`, `next`, `@nestjs/core`, `@nestjs/common`, `aws-lambda`, `@types/aws-lambda`, `@middy/core`, `commander`, `yargs`, `@oclif/core`, `@modelcontextprotocol/*`: `eslint-plugin-node-security`
- `@nestjs/common`, `@nestjs/core`: `eslint-plugin-nestjs-security`
- `react`, `react-dom`, `preact`, `vue`, `svelte`, `@angular/core`, `solid-js`, `lit`, `next`, `nuxt`: `eslint-plugin-browser-security`
- `jsonwebtoken`, `jose`, `express-jwt`, `@nestjs/jwt`, `jwks-rsa`, `jwt-decode`: `eslint-plugin-jwt-security`
- `pg`, `pg-pool`, `pg-promise`, `postgres`, `slonik`: `eslint-plugin-postgresql-security`
- `mysql2`, `mysql`: `eslint-plugin-mysql-security`
- `mongodb`, `mongoose`: `eslint-plugin-mongodb-security`
- `better-sqlite3`, `sqlite3`: `eslint-plugin-sqlite-security`
- `knex`: `eslint-plugin-knex-security`
- `@prisma/client`, `prisma`: `eslint-plugin-prisma-security`
- `drizzle-orm`: `eslint-plugin-drizzle-security`
- `sequelize`: `eslint-plugin-sequelize-security`
- `typeorm`: `eslint-plugin-typeorm-security`
- `@supabase/supabase-js`: `eslint-plugin-supabase-security`
- `@grpc/grpc-js`, `@grpc/reflection`, `grpc-server-reflection`: `eslint-plugin-grpc-security`
- `@modelcontextprotocol/*`: `eslint-plugin-mcp-sdk-security`
- `openai`, `@openai/agents`: `eslint-plugin-openai-security`
- `@anthropic-ai/sdk`, `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`: `eslint-plugin-anthropic-security`
- `@google/genai`: `eslint-plugin-gemini-security`
- `ai`: `eslint-plugin-vercel-ai-security`
- `aws-lambda`, `@types/aws-lambda`, `@middy/core`: `eslint-plugin-lambda-security`

The full stack-to-plugin playbook (with config rendering and a proof step) is the `security-linting` skill: https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/tree/main/skills/security-linting
